specs: What about strollers? >Yes, children of all ages are allowed as the tours are great for all ages and we do allow strollers on board for small kids, Strollers must be stowed away once on board.
Anyone under 18 must be accompanied by an adult but we do offer a reduced-price ticket for children ages 3-11 and kids 2 and under are free.
For infants we recommend you bring a life jacket that fits your small child.

services.name: Dolphin Nature Tour - from FRENCH PRESS COFFEE SHOP Cape Coral
services.desc: Dolphin Nature Tour - Cape Coral On our Dolphin Nature Tour, we cruise the tropical waters of San Carlos Bay and watch the local Bottlenose Dolphins at play with Sanibel Island as our backdrop. This 1.5 hour cruise is one of our most popular tours. Dolphins are the main focus on this excursion. As we depart from the Cape Coral canals and make our way along the Caloosahatchee River out into San Carlos Bay toward Sanibel Island, we are bound to spot some of the many dolphins that call these coastal waters home. Kids and adults alike will learn about these curious creatures as well as other types of marine wildlife on this eco-tour. Rates Adults (12 and Older): $40 Children (3 to 11): $35 Wee

faq.q: o I have to purchase tickets in advance?
faq.a: We highly recommend purchasing your tickets in advance, as tours very often sell out in advance. There is nothing better than knowing you have the day and time booked for the tour you want. Tickets can be purchased with Visa, MasterCard or American Express. Does the tour go out into the Gulf of Mexico? No, we don't go that far out for a couple of reasons.
